summary: Independent adversarial LLM verification of the exact frozen statement and self-contained proof. All ten audit categories pass. (1) Measure: every listed fiber is a full23-simplex, q=23, and normalized Hausdorff additivity gives W=(2^n-1)M+4b. (2) Centers/quantifiers: every actual point of S receives a containing halfspace of insufficient mass; no surrogate center is used. (3) Halfspaces: all cuts are proper, closed ambient halfspaces, including coupled normals; the24 middle cuts cover the entire middle fiber. (4) Lattice: the integer projection census and exposed nonzero bases are exact; only continuous barycentric coordinates are changed. (5) Degeneracy: all constructed fibers have positive full23-volume; source support contacts and cut boundaries are handled with strict other-fiber exclusion. (6) Constants: both positive integer certificates and delta<g were recomputed, proving M<4b and Gamma M>3b/2 exactly. (7) Sharpness/example compatibility: this new counterexample is independent of the cube-times-simplex example, whose behavior is not contradicted; it disproves its universality as an extremizer. (8) Circularity: the proof invokes neither OC nor a completion theorem or unproved source inequality. (9) Limits/attainment: the construction, copy count, exposing functionals and exclusions are finite; a uniform upper bound on every point suffices without maximizing-depth attainment. (10) Classical proof: the chain-simplex determinant, containment margins, origin-fiber regrouping, explicit bad cuts and exposed-simplex cap construction are all proved directly.
